uncertain.text: de tous les parens. dequoy rendra certain teſmoigna-
uncertain.note: first letter of 'teſmoigna-' is ambiguous at 8x: the top bar projects both sides like a t but the foot is flat like the r of 'rien'; could be a wrong sort r ('reſmoigna-'). Read as t by the expected word.

uncertain.text: Sichæus ſon couſin germain & mari de Dido ſa ſeut,
uncertain.note: sic: 'ſeut' for ſeur (sister); the final glyph has a crossbar and curled foot, clearly t not r.

uncertain.text: n'aller poinr a la guerre de Thebes, de peur d'eſtre tué
uncertain.note: sic: 'poinr' for point; the last glyph has the top ear of r and no crossbar. 'a la' printed without grave accent. The print sets 'd' eſtre' with a space after the apostrophe; closed up per word-division rule.

uncertain.text: comme luy auoit eſté predite. Sur quoy le Pœte s'ecri-
uncertain.note: the final e of 'predite' is a small raised (superscript) e, transcribed as plain e. 's'ecri-' is set with a round s before the apostrophe, as printed; likewise 's'emparer' in line 8 and 'qu's'eſtoit' in line 13.

uncertain.text: quel aiguillon de recouurer le riche ioyau qu'Adraſtus
uncertain.note: the print sets 'qu' Adraſtus' with a space after the apostrophe; closed up per word-division rule.

uncertain.text: uerſer & perdre le ſang de la moitié des hommes, voire
uncertain.note: printed tight as 'deshommes'; word division normalized to 'des hommes'.

uncertain.text: reux & excellent en toute vertu, ne reformida rien en
uncertain.note: between 'vertu' and the comma there is a small vertical mark like a raised, broken sort or risen space (it resembles a tiny italic mark). It is not keyed to any note and has been omitted; marker i sits at the end of the paragraph.

uncertain.text: toute vertu {i}.
uncertain.note: between 'vertu' and the italic marker i there is a stray raised mark (colon-like) with a small a-shaped blot beneath it, probably risen spacing material; then the marker i and a period separated by a space. Transcribed as 'vertu {i}.' with the stray mark omitted.

uncertain.text: en quelque lieu Saluſte, renuerſe la foy, la probité &
uncertain.note: after 'Saluſte' a small dot below the baseline precedes the comma (risen space or bad sort); only the comma is transcribed.

uncertain.text: C'eſt pourquoy l'empereur M. Antonin prince gene
uncertain.note: printed 'M . Antonin' with a space before the period; normalized to 'M.'.

uncertain.text: ANNOT XV.
uncertain.note: the heading reads ANNOT XV. with no visible period after ANNOT (only a very faint speck at the top right of the T); transcribed without the point. Compare ANNOTAT. XIIII. on p029.

uncertain.text: Aſçauoir, qu'il n'eſtoit point Martin
uncertain.note: 'Martin' is set with a visible gap ('Mart in'); closed up as a single word.

uncertain.text: nee ladite de Rols à le pourſuyure.
uncertain.note: 'Rols' third glyph is an upright l with a slight cursive top; read as l (the name de Rols), not ſ.

uncertain.text: pre vn ſerf (lequel eſt eſtimé moins que rien, & comme
uncertain.note: the r of 'ſerf' is lightly inked and narrow; at reading size it can look like 'ſeif'. Read as r by the ear at top right. 'deſtourner' in the next line is set with a gap ('deſt ourner'), closed up.

uncertain.text: Si les loix on trouué mauuais de ſuborner & corrõ
uncertain.note: 'corrõ' / 'pre' broken across the line end without a hyphen; tilde over o as printed.

uncertain.text: b. liure de ſa
uncertain.note: second line begins with an italic 'b.' as the book number (sic, presumably for ij.); transcribed as printed. Last line 'ction' is set with a ct ligature.

uncertain.text: Aeneides,
uncertain.note: the mark after 'Aeneides' in note e hangs below the baseline and is read as a comma rather than a point.

uncertain.text: la fin, vt Iude
uncertain.note: 'Iude': first glyph is a plain tall stroke; read as italic capital I (as in 'Iuſtin' two lines below) rather than lowercase l, which in this italic has a looped top. Presumably the Novel 'ut iudices sine quoquo suffragio' (coll. ij.).

uncertain.text: l, quod atti-
uncertain.note: note a begins 'l,' (law) followed by a comma, as printed; 'ſeruitutẽ' carries a tilde over the final e.

uncertain.text: Vergile au
uncertain.note: the key letter of this note is a small italic c (sequence b, c, d); its shape is close to an e.

uncertain.text: Ciceron en
uncertain.note: note e (Ciceron en la ſixieſme Verrine; Vergile au vj. des Aeneides) has no visible {e} marker anywhere in the body: lines 10-14 (Eriphyle / Amphiaraus passage, which the note refers to) were checked at 4x and carry no italic letter. The note is printed beside 'Roy des Argiues auoit' (line 12). Recorded without a marker.
